description: Slow down and allow things to evolve #selflove #trusttheprocess #selfpreservation
transcript: Rushing is terrible and it is not a part of my process, and everything that I do, I take my time. When I take my time, I allow things to evolve. When I'm in a state of acceptance, I'm more cautious about the decisions that I make. I'm more mindful. I do not like to make unnecessary mistakes. Learning to slow down and take my time allows me to be more observant.
